occurrences.text: Some fell upon stony places, where they had not much earth: and forthwith they sprung up, because they had no deepness of earth:
But he that received the seed into stony places, the same is he that heareth the word, and anon with joy receiveth it;
And some fell on stony ground, where it had not much earth; and immediately it sprang up, because it had no depth of earth:
And these are they likewise which are sown on stony ground; who, when they have heard the word, immediately receive it with gladness;

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
